# Loui DS

> Loui DS is a dark, minimal, functional React design system (React 19, React Aria Components, CSS Modules, DTCG tokens) for internal tools, dashboards and apps. It is built to be operated by humans and AI agents.

Package @loui/ds@0.0.0. Entry points: `@loui/ds`, `@loui/ds/patterns`, `@loui/ds/styles.css`. All component and token names below are exact; do not invent others.

Rules for generated UI:

- Use only components, hooks and tokens exported by the package; never write raw colors, px sizes, z-indexes or inline styles.
- One primary action per screen (`Button variant="primary"`), top right. The accent blue is for focus, selection and links only.
- Hierarchy comes from surface plus border; shadows only on overlays.
- Color never carries meaning alone: pair it with text or an icon with a name.
- Every interactive element needs an accessible name; icon-only controls require a `label`.
- Microcopy: English, sentence case, buttons are verb + object, no exclamation marks, no emoji. See content-rules.json.
- No user-visible string literals in components: use the message catalog and `DSProvider`.
- Money is integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code; format dates, numbers and money with the provided utilities.
- Do not use `experimental` or `deprecated` components in recipes or generated code unless the user asks.

- [Getting started](./guides/getting-started.md): Install, load the stylesheet, wrap the app in DSProvider, fonts, SSR.

- [Content guidelines](./guides/content-guidelines.md): Microcopy rules: tone, casing, buttons, errors, empty states, numbers.
- [Accessibility](./guides/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AA target, keyboard model and how it is tested.
- [Using with AI](./guides/using-with-ai.md): The manifest, llms.txt, content rules and Storybook MCP.

## Components

- [Accordion](./ai/components/Accordion.md): A stack of sections that expand and collapse. (experimental)
- [ActionList](./ai/components/ActionList.md): A vertical list of records, each with a title, optional description, a mono meta value and a "more actions" menu. (experimental)
- [AgentCard](./ai/components/AgentCard.md): A card for one agent: icon, name, status, description and a footer with the last activity and the number of items waiting for approval. (experimental)
- [Alert](./ai/components/Alert.md): An inline message with a tone, an icon, an optional title, an action and a dismiss button. (experimental)
- [ApprovalCard](./ai/components/ApprovalCard.md): A reply waiting for approval: the original message, an editable draft written by an agent and two actions, send and discard. (experimental)
- [Avatar](./ai/components/Avatar.md): A circular photo or initials of a person, in grays (never a color per person). (experimental)
- [Badge](./ai/components/Badge.md): A pill with a short status label. (experimental)
- [Breadcrumb](./ai/components/Breadcrumb.md): The path to the current page as an ordered list of links inside a `nav` landmark. (experimental)
- [Button](./ai/components/Button.md): An action button built on React Aria's `Button`. (experimental)
- [Calendar](./ai/components/Calendar.md): A month calendar (React Aria `Calendar`, an ARIA grid). (experimental)
- [Card](./ai/components/Card.md): A bordered surface that groups related content. (experimental)
- [Chart](./ai/components/Chart.md): A responsive bar or line chart for one series, drawn in SVG. (experimental)
- [ChatPanel](./ai/components/ChatPanel.md): A chat side panel for talking to an agent: header with Clear, a message log, suggested prompts when empty, and a composer. (experimental)
- [Checkbox](./ai/components/Checkbox.md): A checkbox with a native `<input type="checkbox">` (so `name` / `value` take part in form submission), an 18px box and an optional description. (experimental)
- [CheckboxGroup](./ai/components/CheckboxGroup.md): A labelled `role="group"` of checkboxes that share one value (`string[]`), one `name`, and one description and error. (experimental)
- [ChoiceTiles](./ai/components/ChoiceTiles.md): Single-choice tiles: a `radiogroup` whose options are drawn as big buttons with a label and an optional meta line. (experimental)
- [ColorOption](./ai/components/ColorOption.md): A selectable option that shows a color swatch and its name. (experimental)
- [Combobox](./ai/components/Combobox.md): A text input with a filtered list of options in a popover (ARIA combobox pattern, built on React Aria `ComboBox`): the input has `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete="list"` and `aria-activedescendant`, so focus stays in the input while the arrow keys move through the list. (experimental)
- [ConfirmDialog](./ai/components/ConfirmDialog.md): A destructive-action confirmation: an `alertdialog` with the question as the title, the consequence in one sentence, a Cancel button and a confirm button that names the action. (experimental)
- [CurrencyInput](./ai/components/CurrencyInput.md): A money field. (experimental)
- [DataTable](./ai/components/DataTable.md): A data table with locale-aware sorting, row selection with a bulk action bar, client-side pagination, loading and empty states. (experimental)
- [DatePicker](./ai/components/DatePicker.md): A date field with a calendar popover (React Aria `DatePicker`). (experimental)
- [Description](./ai/components/Description.md): Helper text under a field (the handoff `hint`). (experimental)
- [Dialog](./ai/components/Dialog.md): A modal dialog built on React Aria `DialogTrigger`, `ModalOverlay`, `Modal` and `Dialog`. (experimental)
- [DueIndicator](./ai/components/DueIndicator.md): A due date with a status in words: "Mar 9 Overdue by 3 days", "Due today", "Due in 5 days", "Paid". (experimental)
- [EmptyState](./ai/components/EmptyState.md): Tells the user that there is nothing to show, why, and what to do next. (experimental)
- [FieldError](./ai/components/FieldError.md): Error text of a field. (experimental)
- [FieldMessages](./ai/components/FieldMessages.md): Description followed by the error: the footer every field renders under its control. (experimental)
- [FileUpload](./ai/components/FileUpload.md): A drop zone with a "Choose files" button and the list of added files (React Aria `DropZone` and `FileTrigger`). (experimental)
- [Icon](./ai/components/Icon.md): An inline SVG icon (Lucide, bundled) that inherits the text color and draws a 1.5px stroke. (experimental)
- [IconButton](./ai/components/IconButton.md): A square button with a single icon and a required accessible name. (experimental)
- [InlineConfirm](./ai/components/InlineConfirm.md): A two-step confirmation without a dialog: the trigger button turns into a question with Cancel and a confirm button, in place. (experimental)
- [Input](./ai/components/Input.md): Single-line text field: label, control, description and error wired together (`for`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`), built on React Aria `TextField`. (experimental)
- [Kbd](./ai/components/Kbd.md): A keyboard shortcut hint in mono type. (experimental)
- [Label](./ai/components/Label.md): The visible label of a field. (experimental)
- [LedgerList](./ai/components/LedgerList.md): A list of signed ledger entries: date, title, optional sub line, a signed amount and an optional running balance. (experimental)
- [Link](./ai/components/Link.md): A link built on React Aria's `Link`. (experimental)
- [MatrixGrid](./ai/components/MatrixGrid.md): A matrix of toggle cells: rows by columns, each cell linking or unlinking one row with one column. (experimental)
- [Menu](./ai/components/Menu.md): A menu of commands that opens from a trigger, built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover` and `Menu`. (experimental)
- [MenuItem](./ai/components/MenuItem.md): One command. (experimental)
- [MenuSection](./ai/components/MenuSection.md): A group of items with an optional caption. (experimental)
- [MenuSeparator](./ai/components/MenuSeparator.md): A 1px line between groups of items. (experimental)
- [Meter](./ai/components/Meter.md): A bar that shows a quantity within a known range (disk used, quota, score), as opposed to progress of a task. (experimental)
- [MoreActionsMenu](./ai/components/MoreActionsMenu.md): The common "more actions" menu: an icon button with three dots whose name comes from the message catalog ("More actions"), opening a `Menu`. (experimental)
- [NavItem](./ai/components/NavItem.md): One entry of a navigation list. (experimental)
- [NumberField](./ai/components/NumberField.md): A number field with minus and plus steppers (the handoff `Stepper`), built on React Aria `NumberField`: a text `<input>` with `aria-roledescription="Number field"` (React Aria deliberately drops `role="spinbutton"`: VoiceOver cannot focus a spin button with typed text). (experimental)
- [Pagination](./ai/components/Pagination.md): Previous and next buttons, numbered page buttons with ellipses, and a text that says where you are ("11–20 of 42", or "Page 2 of 5" when only the page count is known). (experimental)
- [Popover](./ai/components/Popover.md): A floating surface for interactive content (filters, a small form, a color picker), built on React Aria `DialogTrigger`, `Popover` and `Dialog`. (experimental)
- [Progress](./ai/components/Progress.md): A thin bar for a task that makes progress: determinate with a `value`, or indeterminate when the amount is unknown. (experimental)
- [ProportionBar](./ai/components/ProportionBar.md): A single bar split into the parts of a whole (payment methods, composition). (experimental)
- [Radio](./ai/components/Radio.md): One option of a `RadioGroup`. (experimental)
- [RadioGroup](./ai/components/RadioGroup.md): A labelled `role="radiogroup"` of mutually exclusive options with native radio inputs. (experimental)
- [RankList](./ai/components/RankList.md): An ordered list of items with a value, a bar relative to the largest value and an optional detail. (experimental)
- [Rating](./ai/components/Rating.md): A read-only star rating. (experimental)
- [RequiredMark](./ai/components/RequiredMark.md): The visible marker of a required field, text from messages. (experimental)
- [SearchInput](./ai/components/SearchInput.md): A search box: leading search icon, clear button (and `Escape` clears), optional decorative shortcut hint, optional suggestions with accent-insensitive match highlighting. (experimental)
- [SegmentedControl](./ai/components/SegmentedControl.md): A segmented control picks one value from a few options, like a radio group drawn as a bar. (experimental)
- [Select](./ai/components/Select.md): A single-choice dropdown built on React Aria `Select`: a button that opens a listbox in a popover. (experimental)
- [Sheet](./ai/components/Sheet.md): A side panel that slides in from the inline-end edge, for viewing or editing one record without leaving the list. (experimental)
- [Sidebar](./ai/components/Sidebar.md): The app sidebar: a workspace block, navigation sections, an optional status card, a footer slot and the signed-in user. (experimental)
- [Skeleton](./ai/components/Skeleton.md): A placeholder block in the shape of content that is still loading. (experimental)
- [SkipLink](./ai/components/SkipLink.md): A link that is invisible until a keyboard user focuses it, then jumps past the repeated navigation to the main content (WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks). (experimental)
- [Slider](./ai/components/Slider.md): A single-value slider built on React Aria `Slider`: a labelled track with one thumb that is a real `<input type="range">`, so keyboard, pointer, touch and form submission (`name`) work natively. (experimental)
- [Spinner](./ai/components/Spinner.md): An indeterminate loading ring that inherits the text color. (experimental)
- [StatCard](./ai/components/StatCard.md): An indicator card: a mono caption, a large mono number and a short note, optionally with a trend and a small visual (such as a `ProportionBar`) in between. (experimental)
- [StatusSteps](./ai/components/StatusSteps.md): A horizontal indicator of progress through a linear status flow (Draft, Packed, Shipped). (experimental)
- [SubMenu](./ai/components/SubMenu.md): An item that opens a nested menu. (experimental)
- [SuggestionChip](./ai/components/SuggestionChip.md): A dashed chip that proposes a piece of text. (experimental)
- [Swatch](./ai/components/Swatch.md): A small circle filled with a color, with a subtle inset ring so dark colors stay visible on dark surfaces. (experimental)
- [Switch](./ai/components/Switch.md): An on/off setting that applies immediately. (experimental)
- [Tab](./ai/components/Tab.md): One tab of a `TabList`, with an optional count and shortcut hint. (experimental)
- [TabList](./ai/components/TabList.md): The row of tabs. (experimental)
- [TabPanel](./ai/components/TabPanel.md): The content of one tab. (experimental)
- [Tabs](./ai/components/Tabs.md): Tabs switch between panels of related content. (experimental)
- [Tag](./ai/components/Tag.md): A mono outlined label for versions, SKUs and filters. (experimental)
- [TagGroup](./ai/components/TagGroup.md): A group of tags with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation. (experimental)
- [Textarea](./ai/components/Textarea.md): Multi-line text field built on React Aria `TextField` + `TextArea`. (experimental)
- [ToastRegion](./ai/components/ToastRegion.md): Renders the toasts of a queue. (experimental)
- [Tooltip](./ai/components/Tooltip.md): An ink-style hint for a control, built on React Aria `TooltipTrigger` and `Tooltip`. (experimental)
- [TopBar](./ai/components/TopBar.md): The page header: a title with an optional subtitle, or a breadcrumb trail, and an actions slot. (experimental)
- [VisuallyHidden](./ai/components/VisuallyHidden.md): Hides content visually while keeping it available to assistive technology. (stable)

## Hooks, utilities and icons

- [Hooks and utilities](./ai/hooks-and-utilities.md): useControllableState, useDSLocale, useHotkey, useMediaQuery, useMessages, usePrefersReducedMotion, useToast; 37 utilities and constants; 24 icons.

## Machine-readable data

- [manifest.json](./manifest.json): every export with props, variants, messages, CSS variables, stories and doc sections (81 components).
- [tokens.json](./tokens.json): 314 design tokens with CSS variables, values, descriptions and allowed text/surface pairings.
- [content-rules.json](./ai/content-rules.json): microcopy rules as data.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): guides, token summary and every component page in one file.
